required_fixes: Fix V3 selection bias after 304 exclusion: valid cache-enabled non-304 composition is skewed (profile 2, data_list 2, session_status 40 valid vs 40/40/40 expired). Pooled cache-enabled r is biased (-0.452 non-304 vs -0.237 inclusive). Recompute C3/C4/C5 with endpoint-stratified or balanced weighting, not raw pooled concatenation. Report per-endpoint non-304 r's (profile 0.009 n=122, data_list 0.122 n=122, session -0.013 n=160) and stratified pooled estimate.

Fix C5 to exclude 304 from per-cache correlations as frozen prereg requires. Producer C5 includes 304 (run_experiment.py per-cache loop uses all OK samples, not non-304 filter). Correct non-304 C5: r_enabled=-0.453 n=164, r_disabled=0.014 n=240, diff=0.466 > 2*SE=0.204 FAIL more strongly than reported 0.251 >0.184. Update run_experiment.py to apply V3 filter to C5 and per-endpoint correlations.

Fix _make_unauthorized_response ETag permission leakage: expired tokens decode as expired without permission_level payload, so fallback 'read' etag (c6b1...) is used for write-permission expired requests, causing write valid etag c471... vs expired c6b1... mismatch. Compute stable_key from request permission_level independent of token expiry (pass permission_level explicitly or derive from session). Verify ETag independence via check that valid and expired write etags overlap.

Fix TOST pass logic inconsistency: tost_equivalence() returns pass = pu<0.05 AND pl<0.05 (two-sided), but spec decision rule is one-sided pu<0.05 only. Metrics tost_at_delta_015_testbed.pass=false while Controls C4_tost.pass=true. Align metric pass to one-sided spec or report both clearly.

Re-run B-PARENT-CONFOUND with correct effect size power analysis: observed |r|=0.120 <0.15 fails C7, but per-endpoint bparent shows -0.406/-0.317 for profile/data_list vs -0.032 for session_status. Investigate why header-only fix (uuid vs token_hex) yields only 0.12 pooled when parent V1 was 0.17. Test larger n>=800 or stronger entropy bifurcation to determine if V1 confound is weaker than assumed or if header-only extraction dilutes effect.

Disclose and correct report that per_endpoint_r_testbed includes 304 samples (producer reports r=-0.378/-0.256/-0.013 n=160). Correct non-304 per-endpoint r's are 0.009/0.122/-0.013 and change interpretation from moderate negative coupling to near-zero within-endpoint orthogonality.

validity_findings.finding: V3 FIX (exclude 304 from correlation) corrects structural composite construction (fixed 0.2 vs sha256 hash) but leaves token-state-dependent sampling selection: valid cache-enabled non-304 n=44 (profile 2, data_list 2, session 40) vs expired n=120 (balanced). Session_status has higher structural mean ~0.57 vs profile ~0.29, so pooling creates spurious negative r. Validated by raw_evidence/experiment_data.json: valid+cache+read+user_profile has 19/20 304, leaving 1 non-304 per write/read. Producer does not disclose this bias.

C3 one-sided pass remains true after stratification, but C5 fail is inflated by bias and cannot be interpreted as infrastructure-induced coupling without stratified correction.

validity_findings.finding: testbed_server.py _make_unauthorized_response() computes ETag from stable_key f'{path}_{permission_level}' but for expired tokens validate_token returns error payload without permission_level, so permission_level defaults to 'read'. Write-permission expired requests get read etag c6b1... vs valid write etag c471..., leaking behavioral state into structural ETag. Confirmed: per_condition_data for /api/user/profile write perm valid etag c471... unique, expired etag c6b1... overlap 0.

validity_findings.impact: Structural signal not fully independent per spec clause 8 for write perm expired conditions. Effect size small within-condition (etag_variation 0) but violates measurement validity and should be fixed before VALIDATED claim.

claim_ceiling: C-FRESHNESS remains EXPERIMENTAL bounded to localhost stochastic Flask mock (r=0.002-0.046, n=480, audit PASS across 4 experiments). Production-like testbed evidence is MIXED/REJECTED at delta=0.15 under corrected measurement: pooled non304 |r|=0.126 passes one-sided equivalence (CI upper -0.029 <0.15, p_upper 1.3e-08) and per-endpoint non304 r ~0.01-0.12 suggests within-endpoint orthogonality, but C5 heterogeneity FAIL (diff 0.466 >0.204 even after 304 exclusion) and C7 negative control FAIL (|r|=0.12 <0.15) block CONFIRMED. Residual selection bias and ETag permission leakage require fixes and stratified re-analysis at n>=800 before VALIDATED. No evidence supports PRODUCT_CORE or SHIPPED.
